content.summary: Mid-cap stocks often strike the right balance between having proven business models and market opportunities that can support $100 billion corporations. However, they face intense competition from scaled industry giants and can be disrupted by new innovative players vying for a slice of the pie.

content.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks We Keep Off Our Radar

content.title: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Meta, Microsoft, Alphabet, FMC, C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Roblox, Metsera, Chipotle, and More
content.summary: Shares of companies in the tech sector led the decline in the wake of quarterly earnings from Meta Platforms and Microsoft.  Meta Platforms  missed analysts’ third-quarter earnings expectations and the stock declined 11%.  Meta said the earnings miss included a one-time tax charge of $15.93 billion from the implementation of the Trump administration’s One Big Beautiful Bill Act.
